strings.MAU_idea_mauritanian_claims_desc: Moustapha Ould Mohamed Saleck and the Military Committee for National Recovery claim to be the legitimate rulers of the former French colony of Mauritania. These claims include vast regions currently controlled by Iberia. While few in the international community take Mauritania's ambitions seriously, within the country they are vital to maintaining political stability. Without the claims, the ruling Military Committee for National Recovery would lose all reason to exist. It remains to be seen if they will even have an opportunity to press them.
strings.MAU_idea_mauritanian_claims_tt: If the opportunity presents itself, the CMRN shall push their claim.
strings.MAU_idea_military_committee_national_rec: The Military Committee for National Recovery

In order to secure the stability and unity of the nation, and prepare for the reclamation of the rest of Mauritania, the military leaders of Mauritania have formed a junta and outlawed other political organizations, doing away with all forms of democracy in the name of eliminating political division and uniting the people. Mauritania is a nation without politics, for the moment at least.
